NAME OSHKOSH TRANSFER CASE ACQUISITION 18 August 2026 1. AUTHORITY: This Determination and Finding (D&F) is prepared in accordance with the authority of RFO 12.102(a), which permits the use of a brand name specification when it is essential to the Government's requirements, thereby restricting competition. 2. FINDINGS: 1. Description: The 5th Logistics Readiness Squadron (5 LRS) has a requirement to purchase a replacement transfer case for a 2020 OshKosh HB2723CZ-GOP Snow Removal Truck. 2. Requirement for Brand Name: Is due to the Patent of the Item. Oshkosh is the manufacturer of the snow removal truck and has patented specifications that no other company is allowed to copy and/or sell under any other name. Replacement parts manufactured by any other company that makes transfer cases will have different connections that will be inoperable with the Government’s Oshkosh Snow Removal Truck. 3. Efforts to Obtain Competition: There are several authorized distributors that sell OshKosh manufactured parts. The solicitation will be posted to SAM.gov to encourage competition. 4. Steps to Preclude Future Brand Name Awards: Future brand name awards will be dependent on the life of the snow removal truck. Opportunities to preclude brand name awards will be dependent o

mpetition: There are several authorized distributors that sell OshKosh manufactured parts. The solicitation will be posted to SAM.gov to encourage competition. 4. Steps to Preclude Future Brand Name Awards: Future brand name awards will be dependent on the life of the snow removal truck. Opportunities to preclude brand name awards will be dependent on the type/brand of replacement vehicles purchased by the Air Force in the future. 3. DETERMINATION: Based on the findings above, I hereby determine that the procurement of the transfer case for the OshKosh Snow Removal Truck on a brand-name basis is essential to the Government’s requirements and is in the best interest of the United States Government. The need for interoperability and the leveraging of existing government investments preclude the consideration of products from another manufacturer. KERI D. staffing_team.text: ===== FILE: files/RDS_FRP_Contract_RFI_FINAL_for_SAM_18_AUG_2026_PDF.pdf ===== 1 Request for Information For: Radiological Detection System (RDS) Disclaimer This is a Request for Information (RFI) only issued by the Department of Defense, Department of the Army, Capability Program Executive Office for Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear Defense (CPE-CBRND), Joint Project Manager Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear Integrated Early Warning (JPM CBRN IEW). This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP), a Broad Agency Announcement (BAA), or a promise to issue a future solicitation. This RFI does not contractually commit the U.S. Government to procure any supply or service, nor does it commit the Government to enter into any contractual agreement. The U.S. Government will not pay for any costs or expenses associated with developing, preparing, or submitting a response to this RFI. While responses are highly encouraged, not respond

deliverables_scope.text: rnment. The Government reserves the right to use information provided by respondents for any purpose deemed necessary and legally appropriate. The information in this RFI is subject to change and is not binding. Any future postings or announcements that contradict this document will supersede the language herein. No classified information shall be submitted in response to this RFI. 1.0 Purpose: The objective of this Request for Information is to identify interested sources and assess industrial capabilities for the manufacturing, testing, and delivery of a Radiological Detection System (RDS) that adheres to the attached Performance Specification (P-Spec). Potential vendors are welcome to submit proposals for the complete system, the base unit only, or specific probes.
